feature_protocol.calendar: Complete market sessions; never bridge missing stock quotes
feature_protocol.adjustment: Actual daily adj_factor; no future month-end interpolation
feature_protocol.stage_labels: Past-only weak context: breakout, reversal, continuation, range
feature_protocol.universe: All supplied SH/SZ boards including ChiNext and STAR; buy restriction is execution-only
feature_protocol.scaling: Fixed clipping bounds here; train-only standardization in model

graph_coverage.reason: Explicit no-graph ablation; no collection result enters this model

graph_freshness: Latest verified dated snapshot only, carried forward; no current backfill
graph_gaps: Unknown edges do not exclude stocks; collection failures are retained in graph coverage
